title: Zoom the timeline with the trackpad, both ways, and lose the zoom buttons
goal: User 2026-09-28: 'the zooming options are super weird as buttons - I'd rather use trackpad zooming to gracefully zoom in both horizontally or vertically.' Today the timeline has zoom buttons (Fit and steps, from the-timeline-is-the-one-in-the-mock / timeline zoom). Standard: Final Cut and Premiere pinch to zoom time around the pointer; Option- or Cmd-scroll changes track height.
acceptance: Pinch on the timeline zooms BOTH ways at once, anchored on the pointer: time grows horizontally and rows grow taller vertically, so the moment AND the row under the pointer stay under the pointer through the whole pinch (user 2026-09-28: 'I want vertical zoom to make the rows larger, but centered where my mouse is'); smooth and continuous, 60 fps, from the whole document to single frames

Option-pinch zooms time only, and Shift-pinch zooms row height only, both still anchored on the pointer; row height has sensible limits (compact to about 4x) and the track headers grow with their rows
Two-finger scroll pans in both directions with momentum; Shift-scroll pans time

Nothing jumps when zooming (user 2026-09-28: 'it causes a horizontal zoom scrollbar to appear and disappear. this causes the page to jump'): the timeline's scrollers sit at its bottom edge (time) and right edge (rows), as overlay-style bars in space that is always reserved, so their appearing, disappearing or resizing never moves the tracks, the ruler, the transport or anything above; a walk pinches in and out 20 times and fails if any row's or the ruler's y position changes by even one point
The zoom buttons are removed; Fit remains only as a key (Shift-Z, as Premiere) and in the timeline's right-click menu; = and - still zoom around the playhead
Zoom is kept per document and restored when it reopens
Walk measures that the time under the pointer stays under the pointer through a pinch, and photographs zoomed out, zoomed in, and tall tracks

log.note: User 2026-09-28: a plain pinch zooms both ways, rows taller as well as time wider, anchored on the pointer in x and y. Acceptance updated.
User 2026-09-28: the horizontal scrollbar appearing/disappearing while zooming makes the page jump; scrollers go bottom/right in reserved space. Acceptance updated.

Review before building: (1) the jump the user saw is the overview bar appearing ABOVE the ruler whenever the timeline is opened out, which grows the dock by 15pt and pushes the ruler, transport and picture; fix = scrollers in always-reserved space at the bottom (time) and right (rows). (2) Row zoom must not grow the dock either, or plain pinch would move everything above; the dock keeps its height and taller rows scroll inside it, as Premiere's panel does. (3) Pinch anchor today is x only and the closest zoom is one second across, which is ~30 frames: not single frames; bring the closest window to a quarter second and let the ruler write hundredths. (4) Shift-Z is Punch In's key in the menu: when the timeline has the keyboard Shift-Z fits, and it falls through to Punch In while a region is drawn. (5) A trackpad pinch cannot be synthesized, so the walk drives the same call the gesture makes (as the canvas pinch step does). (6) Mouse users keep Option-scroll to zoom time; Cmd-scroll grows rows, per the goal's Premiere/FCP note.
owns these walks: timeline-pinch-both-ways-walk, open-out-the-timeline-walk, the-timeline-is-the-one-in-the-mock-walk

Built: pinch zooms time+rows anchored on the pointer (EditorState.pinchTimeline, TimelineRowZoom in core), Option=time, Shift=rows, Cmd-scroll rows, Option-scroll time at pointer; zoom buttons removed; scrollers (TimelineScrollers.swift) live in the dock's existing bottom/right margins so the dock height at Fit is byte-identical to before and nothing ever moves; Shift-Z fits (falls through to Punch In when a region is drawn); Zoom to Fit + Compact Tracks on ruler and track right-click; zoom+row height kept per file (TimelineViewMemory, forgotten by walks under 'motion'); closest zoom 1s -> 250ms, ruler in hundredths. New walk step timelinePinch checks anchor drift + ruler/dock/rows movement after every nudge; timeline-pinch-both-ways-walk green at Next defaults (240 option nudges, 0 moves, 0 drifts). 16 timeline walks + zoom walks + marquee walks green; first-long-jump-when-zoomed-in-walk failed once at 51ms vs 50ms then passed twice (noise).
